# MetrAIyux 0S · Skye Visual Standard Theme Pack v4

This package extends the MetrAIyux 0S website, Copy Vault, Expanded Copy Vault, and Skye Design MCP Bridge with a real theme and image-standard layer.

## New route
- `themes/index.html` — Skye Visual Standard Theme Lab.

## New assets
- `assets/themes/skye-visual-themes.css`
- `assets/themes/skye-theme-engine.js`
- `assets/themes/skye-theme-manifest.json`
- `assets/themes/skye-themed-icons-manifest.json`
- `assets/themes/icons/<theme>/` themed SVG variants
- `assets/themes/icons-png/<theme>/` themed PNG variants
- `themes/components/` standalone copy-paste components
- `themes/snippets/` all-in-one snippets and image recipes

## Included color systems
- Sovereign Aurora — Primary Skye command look: void, electric blue, crown gold, cyan aura.
- Royal Violet — Luxury founder-grade purple with gold crown pressure and blue-white rim light.
- Solar Crown — Gold-first executive signal for premium decks, price cards, and authority surfaces.
- Citadel Emerald — Security, infrastructure, vault, compliance, database, and trust lanes.
- Blood Moon — High-pressure launch, warning, urgency, command escalation, and cinematic promo surfaces.
- Arctic Neon — Clean high-definition AI, docs, office, product tutorial, and developer-room surfaces.
- Ghost Steel — Professional neutral steel for legal, docs, enterprise proof, and conservative client pages.
- Obsidian Dragon — Streetwear, music, arcade, launch trailers, and more aggressive Skye spectacle.

## Usage
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/site.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/themes/skye-visual-themes.css">
<script defer src="/assets/themes/skye-theme-engine.js"></script>
<html data-skye-theme="sovereign-aurora">
```

The real MetrAIyux 0S logo asset remains preserved. No generated replacement logo was introduced.
